name: volleymetrics-mcp
description: Production-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Volleymetrics and Hudl volleyball analytics
author: Volleymetrics MCP Team

tools.name: get_user_teams
tools.description: Discover and list all Volleymetrics teams and accounts associated with your credentials

tools.name: list_volleyball_matches
tools.description: Fetch match schedule and recent games for a team from Volleymetrics

tools.name: get_match_player_stats
tools.description: Fetch athlete box scores and volleyball statistics for a match

tools.name: get_rotation_breakdown
tools.description: Fetch tactical performance metrics broken down by rotation (P1-P6)

tools.name: get_game_actions
tools.description: Retrieve tagged volleyball actions and touch events with DataVolley (.dvw) codes

tools.name: download_match_dvw
tools.description: Download or generate official DataVolley (.dvw) scouting file or Sportscode XML

tools.name: login_to_volleymetrics
tools.description: Open an interactive pop-up browser window to log into Volleymetrics

tools.name: refresh_volleymetrics_cookie
tools.description: Refresh session token or guide user to interactive login

prompts.name: scout_opponent
prompts.description: Generate a tactical scouting report on an opponent team

prompts.name: analyze_rotation_weaknesses
prompts.description: Diagnose sideout and point scoring vulnerabilities across rotations P1-P6

prompts.name: match_mvp_breakdown
prompts.description: Select the match MVP using advanced volleyball metrics and clutch touch analysis

prompts.name: datavolley_export
prompts.description: Translate match touch data into standardized DataVolley (.dvw) scouting codes

prompts.name: serve_receive_audit
prompts.description: Conduct a serve-receive and passing performance audit
